parameters.reasoning: The paper uses VASP with PBE functional, a plane-wave cutoff of 500 eV, and a 2D monolayer of C2Si. SIESTA uses NAO basis, so plane-wave parameters have no direct equivalent. The paper states a k-grid of 13×13×1 for geometry optimization and 21×21×1 for electronic structure, but SIESTA requires the vacuum axis to have exactly 1 division for 2D systems. The paper does not specify a mesh cutoff (SIESTA's real-space grid), so we choose 300 Ry for light elements. The paper uses PBE functional, so SIESTA maps to GGA/PBE. The paper does not specify basis size, so we assume DZP (standard for production). The paper does not report any parameters that SIESTA needs but the paper didn't state, so we list those in unmapped.
